definitions.explanation: To misplace or no longer have something that you once possessed. This is transitive - you lose something.

definitions.gloss: to get rid of, to eliminate
definitions.explanation: To remove or eliminate something undesirable.

examples.japanese: {財布|さいふ}を{無|な}くしてしまいました。
{鍵|かぎ}を{無|な}くさないでください。
この{問題|もんだい}を{無|な}くしたい。
examples.english: I want to eliminate this problem.

notes: 無くす conjugates as a godan verb: 無くさない (negative), 無くして (te-form), 無くした (past). This is the transitive verb - you lose something. The intransitive counterpart is 無くなる (for something to disappear or run out).
